soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs white with a yellowish tinge, short setae scattered over the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.64, lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal pore dot-like, situated behind the anterior third. Frons of the single-peak type; in profile the frontal peak is moderately raised with an anterior slope of about 40 degrees and a posterior slope of about 160 degrees. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.2 times as long as wide, apical setae rather long and subapical setae minute. Mandibles sabre-shaped, apex slightly curved, left mandible 0.6–0.62 times head capsule length. Antennae 15 segments, the third or fourth the shortest. Anterior lateral margins of the postmentum trapezoidal, widest at the anterior fifth; waist region in the middle, margins parallel, postmentum 7.35–7.62 times as long as the waist width, waist constriction index 0.4–0.41. Pronotum 1.49–1.66 times as wide as long, anterior margin broadly incised, posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle; about 20 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
